body.name: DH
body.def: \(\mathfrak D_H=\{q\in\Delta(\mathcal C_H^{\mathrm{adm}}):q(c)>0\ \text{ for every required supported cell }c,\ d_{H,r}(q)>0\ \text{ for }r=1,\ldots,R\}\). This branch-specific set lists every cell margin and every reduced denominator whose positivity is required to execute the associated returned circuit.
